## Commands: still valid vs clearly wrong

### Still valid

```text
uv run python scripts/build_published_dataset.py
uv run python scripts/build_published_dataset.py --dry-run
uv run python scripts/build_published_dataset.py --job league|tournament
uv run python scripts/build_published_dataset.py --skip-legacy-scrape   # opt-out (undocumented in most MD)
uv run python scripts/build_players_registry.py

uv run python scripts/export_gf_tables.py
uv run python scripts/scrape_legacy_liga.py --season …
uv run python extract_excel_data.py --mode analyze|process|…
uv run python scripts/import_tournaments.py …
uv run python scripts/publish_tournament_parquet.py   # VPS clubmeisterschaft path
uv run python scripts/rebuild_league_caches.py --all-published …
uv run python scripts/warm_league_cache.py …
uv run python scripts/warm_cache_shard.py … / warm_league_cache_shard.py
.\deploy\deploy.ps1 -SyncDatabase [-SyncCache]
uv run python scripts/audit_{nbm,sbm,bm}_imports.py
uv run python scripts/audit_female_league_split.py
uv run python scripts/audit_league_standings.py
uv run python scripts/audit_player_id_names.py
```

`--with-legacy-scrape` is a **deprecated no-op** (harmless if left in old muscle memory).

### Clearly wrong / misleading in docs

| Mentioned in docs | Problem |
|-------------------|---------|
| `--with-legacy-scrape` as the way to include scrape | Wrong polarity — scrape is default |
| Full rebuild = `build_published_dataset.py --with-legacy-scrape` | Same; bare command already merges scrape when file exists |
| `python "league_analyzer_v1/scripts/run_gf_pipeline.py"` | Path is `scripts/run_gf_pipeline.py` + prefer `uv run` |
| `rebuild_form92_legacy_from_staging.py` | Script not in repo |
| `--with-player-hybrid` as normal publish | Deprecated; Spieler merges at runtime |
| “League publish does not rebuild registry” (`ARTIFACTS.md`) | Orchestrator auto-builds `players_registry` first |
| `python -m data_access.build_relational_csv` (`relational_csv/README.md`) | Superseded by mapping/registry flow |
| README `python wsgi.py` / FastAPI migration | Stale entrypoint/story |

## Proposed structure

### `docs/DATA_PIPELINE.md` (central — write new)

Single operator mental model:

1. **Sources** — historical Excel → legacy scrape → GF league → (extra)  
2. **Tournaments** — GF tables + manual/PDF/`import_tournaments` + clubmeisterschaft  
3. **Identity / orgs** — `players_registry`, `affiliation_index`, `clubs_registry`, `club_mapping.csv`  
4. **Publish** — `build_published_dataset` (defaults, opt-outs, audits, manifest)  
5. **Cache / deploy** — warm → `-SyncDatabase` / `-SyncCache`  
6. Links into focused children + Diagnose

### Optional `docs/pipeline/`

| File | Content | Source material |
|------|---------|-----------------|
| `fetch.md` | Excel extract, `scrape_legacy_liga`, GF `run_gf_pipeline`, `export_gf_tables`, `scrape_legacy_tournaments` | Trim from `Excel_Extraction.md` + GF runbook |
| `validate.md` | Female split, standings, player_id_name, tournament quality/club gaps, publish gate | From ARTIFACTS + Excel audits section |
| `import.md` | Clubmeisterschaft VPS, `import_tournaments`, PDF gaps, club_mapping import | Keep gap tables; link Clubmeisterschaft doc |
| `publish.md` | Orchestrator jobs, flags (`--skip-legacy-scrape`, registry, force-publish), warm/cache | Fix `database/data/README` + ARTIFACTS into this |

Keep `database/README.md` as **path/mount contract** only (short pointer to DATA_PIPELINE.md).
